pinout.drain: pin 2 (tab is also drain on DPAK)
pinout.notes: DPAK: pin 1 source, pin 2 gate, pin 3 drain — CONFIRM against datasheet figure for this exact part.

id_conditions: T_C=25 C, V_GS=-10 V. Magnitudes shown.
typical_applications: High-side load switch on 19 V adapter rail
verification_notes: Electrical ratings verified against AOS datasheet. DPAK pin numbering (1 source / 2 gate / 3 drain) needs reconfirmation against the live datasheet figure for the specific reel; some AOS DPAK parts put drain on pin 2 and gate on pin 3, the inverse of common convention.
replacement_notes: P-channel FETs are commonly used as high-side switches on the adapter/battery rail. Replacement MUST match VDS margin to adapter peak (typically >=30V) and provide logic-level drive if the gate is pulled by a 5V signal.
